name: DMT
warning: Uses rapid flicker/shimmer. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: 8–13 Hz shimmer on high-contrast edges — faster than anything else in the set.
Light: crisp fast geometry inside textures; colors already saturated (colorSat is early and maxed).
Common: chrysanthemum mandala blooming over the scene center, masked by luminance.
Strong: geometry dominant, photo ghosting through; symmetry (late) folds the field kaleidoscopically.
Heavy: breakthrough — full tunnel + entity layer crossfades in, photo dissolved, palette seeded from the image's own dominant colors.
